nodes.label: Data360 API traps (WGI estimate filter, ignored timePeriodFrom, no all-rows fallback)
nodes.norm_label: data360 api traps (wgi estimate filter, ignored timeperiodfrom, no all-rows fallback)
nodes.rationale: Only COMP_BREAKDOWN_1=WGI_EST gives estimates; Data360 can ignore timePeriodFrom so the 2010 cutoff is enforced in code; falling back to all rows silently picked percentile ranks.

nodes.label: Refresh button is local-only
nodes.rationale: Public ngrok visitors could otherwise trigger World Bank downloads (firewall blocks heavy clients); ngrok routes by Host header so remote visitors cannot pose as localhost.

nodes.label: Region filtering after scoring
nodes.rationale: A country's score depends only on itself, the ideal and weights, so filtering afterwards gives identical scores and is simpler.
